items.question: What is Photo Stamp?
items.answer: Photo Stamp adds date, time, and location to photos and videos you already have. Processing stays on your device. Package: com.zuki.apps.photostamp.

items.question: Are my photos uploaded?
items.answer: No. There is no account and no upload. Media stays on the device.

items.question: Do you overwrite originals?
items.answer: No. Export creates a new file. Originals are never overwritten.

items.question: Do you need location permission?
items.answer: No GPS permission is required to stamp the gallery. Location appears only if the file already has it, or if you type a place.

items.question: Is this a GPS camera or AI editor?
items.answer: No. Photo Stamp is not a GPS camera, survey tool, or AI editor.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Photo Stamp: Date & Location — on-device stamping, no media upload.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use Photo Stamp: Date & Location and related pages at zukiapps.com/photo-stamp. Photo Stamp stamps date, time, and location onto photos and videos you already have. Media is processed on your device. We do not upload your photos or videos.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the Photo Stamp app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: Photo Stamp works on files you select. We do not upload media to our servers.
items: Photos and videos you select — processed locally to read metadata and render a stamp
Date, time, and location already stored on the file (EXIF / similar metadata)
Optional place text you type if a file has no location
App preferences such as stamp style — stored on device
Support email — if you contact us directly

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Read date, time, and location already on your files
Render a stamp and export a new copy on your device
Remember stamp preferences on your device
Respond to support requests
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information. We do not use your media for advertising profiles or AI training.

section4.title: 4. Photos, videos, and location
section4.content: The app accesses media you select from your library (camera is optional). Location on the stamp comes from file metadata or text you type — not from a live GPS request for gallery stamping.
section4.content2: If a file has no location metadata, that field is hidden. We do not invent a location. You can revoke photo or camera permission in system settings at any time.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Media and exported copies remain on your device until you delete them or uninstall the app. Originals are never overwritten.
section5.content2: Support emails are retained as long as needed to resolve your request.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Free users may see ads. Ad networks (for example Google AdMob) may collect device advertising identifiers under their policies. Photo Stamp Pro (one-time unlock) removes ads.
section6.content2: Purchases are processed by Apple App Store or Google Play. We do not receive your full payment card details. System share sheet and photo library are governed by Apple or Google policies.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: Photo Stamp is rated 4+ / general audiences. It is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.
